skipIntro.skip.description: Roku player button, shown during a TV episode's intro. Selecting it jumps past the intro.

skipIntro.watch.description: Roku player button shown at the intro when the user chose to be asked; selecting it keeps playing the intro instead of skipping.

skipIntro.skipped.description: Small caption above the Roku player's intro button, confirming the intro was just skipped.

upNext.heading.description: Heading of the Up Next panel on Roku, shown near the end of an episode above the next episode's card.

upNext.headingEnded.description: Heading of the Roku Up Next panel after playback has ended, while the next episode is about to start automatically.

upNext.playNow.description: Primary pill button on the Roku Up Next panel that starts the next episode immediately.

upNext.keepWatching.description: Secondary pill button on the Roku Up Next panel that dismisses it and keeps watching the current video.

upNext.autoPlayOn.description: Status line on the Roku Up Next panel saying the next episode will start automatically.

upNext.autoPlayOff.description: Status line on the Roku Up Next panel saying the next episode will not start automatically.

upNext.headingNothing.description: Heading of the Roku Up Next panel when no next episode exists, above suggestions from On Deck.

upNext.headingFinished.description: Heading of the Roku Up Next panel when playback has ended and there is no next episode.

upNext.almostFinished.description: Title on the Roku Up Next panel when no next episode exists and the video is nearly over.

upNext.endOfPlayback.description: Title on the Roku Up Next panel when no next episode exists and playback has ended.

upNext.finding.description: Loading text on the Roku Up Next panel while the app looks up the next episode.

upNext.noNext.description: Message on the Roku Up Next panel when there is no next episode and nothing else to suggest.

upNext.noNextOnDeck.description: Message on the Roku Up Next panel when there is no next episode; the On Deck row below offers other titles to pick from.

upNext.lookupFailed.description: Error message on the Roku Up Next panel when the next episode could not be loaded; the On Deck row below offers alternatives, or the user can go back.

upNext.lookupFailedAlone.description: Error message on the Roku Up Next panel when the next episode could not be loaded and no alternatives are shown; the user can go back.

upNext.onDeck.description: Row heading on the Roku Up Next panel for On Deck, the user's in-progress and next-up titles.

upNext.headingShuffle.description: Heading of the Roku Up Next panel while shuffle is on, meaning the next item is chosen at random.

upNext.shuffling.description: Badge on the Roku Up Next panel during shuffle. {scope}: what is being shuffled, such as a show or library name.

upNext.picking.description: Loading text on the Roku Up Next panel while shuffle picks a random item.

upNext.pickAnother.description: Secondary pill button on the Roku Up Next panel during shuffle that picks a different random item.

upNext.stopShuffling.description: Roku option that turns shuffle off so playback continues normally.

upNext.shuffleDone.description: Message on the Roku Up Next panel when no remaining item in the current shuffle can be played.

upNext.shuffleContinueFailed.description: Roku notice shown when the app failed to continue the shuffle to the next item.

upNext.pickAnotherFailed.description: Roku notice shown when the Pick Another button failed to choose a new random item.

topBar.search.description: Label for the search circle button in the Roku home top bar.

topBar.home.description: Home tab in the Roku top navigation bar.

topBar.movies.description: Movies tab in the Roku top navigation bar, opening the movies library.

topBar.series.description: Series tab in the Roku top navigation bar, opening the TV shows library.

topBar.forYou.description: For You tab in the Roku top navigation bar, and the header of its menu with Watchlist, Favorites and recommendations.

topBar.calendar.description: Calendar tab in the Roku top navigation bar, showing upcoming releases.

topBar.profile.description: Label of the profile button in the Roku top bar. {name}: the current profile's name.

menu.switchProfile.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that returns to the profile picker to switch to another profile.

menu.changeAccount.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that switches to a different server account.

menu.watchlist.description: Row in the Roku For You menu and avatar menu that opens the user's watchlist.

menu.favorites.description: Row in the Roku For You menu that opens the user's favorited titles.

menu.history.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that opens the watch history.

menu.requests.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that opens media requests, shown only when the server offers requests.

menu.signOut.description: Destructive row in the Roku avatar menu that starts signing out; a confirmation dialog follows.

menu.diagnostics.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that opens diagnostics, shown only in debug builds.

menu.connectPhone.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that opens the screen for controlling this TV app from a phone.

menu.settings.description: Row in the Roku avatar menu that opens the Settings screen.

connect.headline.description: Large headline on the Roku Connect a Phone screen. The line break is intentional.

connect.body.description: Instruction on the Roku Connect a Phone screen. {name}: the name of this TV device as shown in the phone app.

connect.none.description: Status line on the Roku Connect a Phone screen when no phone is connected.

connect.phones.description: Status line on the Roku Connect a Phone screen listing connected phones. {names}: comma-separated phone names.

connect.fallback.description: Hint on the Roku Connect a Phone screen beside a QR code. {address}: the TV's network address and port to type in, such as 192.168.1.5:8080.

connect.notListening.description: Message on the Roku Connect a Phone screen when the TV app cannot accept phone connections now.

connect.pairingOn.description: Toggle button on the Roku Connect a Phone screen showing that phones must enter a pairing code.

connect.pairingOff.description: Toggle button on the Roku Connect a Phone screen showing that phones can connect without a pairing code.

connect.resetPairing.description: Button on the Roku Connect a Phone screen that generates a new pairing code.

connect.pairingCode.description: Line on the Roku Connect a Phone screen showing the code to enter on the phone. {code}: the numeric pairing code.

connect.connected.description: Brief on-screen notice on Roku when a phone connects. {name}: the phone's device name.
